WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebrate) as avg_rebrate, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal 
  FROM fees 
  WHERE orderslink IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY orderslink
), overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebrate) as overall_avg_rebrate 
  FROM group_stats 
  WHERE avg_rebrate IS NOT NULL
) 
SELECT g.orderslink, g.avg_rebrate, g.avg_rebtotal, g.avg_rebrate - o.overall_avg_rebrate as rebrate_diff 
FROM group_stats g 
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o 
WHERE o.overall_avg_rebrate IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY CASE WHEN rebrate_diff IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, rebrate_diff DESC 
LIMIT 10
